arguments.text: Current work.py validates rows in input order with priority id, amount, unit, duplicate; rejects bool, negative, nonnumeric, NaN/infinite float amounts; accepts arbitrarily large nonnegative ints without math.isfinite overflow; treats unhashable unit values as unit errors; defaults missing unit, converts valid records, clears all records on any error, and does not mutate inputs. Current report.json exactly matches evaluating requests.json with policy.json. Local checks exercised conversion/defaults, all four error priorities, atomic failure, nonfinite values, huge ints, unhashable units, input immutability, compilation, and report equality.
